name: Yamaha TW200
engine: 196 cc air-cooled SOHC single, one carb, fat tires
intro: A simple, tough trail bike. Routine care for most years. The 2026 model has a speedometer recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2026 TW200s are in recall 26V197 because the speedometer gear may fail. Yamaha says not to ride until it's fixed.
A-002.reason: A dead speedometer makes it hard to judge speed. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Speedometer gear may deform and stop the speedometer. Do not ride until repaired.
